pois.name: Batu Bolong Beach
pois.description: Canggu's most popular beach and surf break. Black volcanic sand, consistent waves, and a temple perched on the headland.

pois.name: Pura Batu Bolong
pois.description: Sea temple perched on a volcanic rock outcrop at Batu Bolong Beach. Ceremonies held at sunset.

pois.name: Echo Beach
pois.description: Long beach with strong beach-break surf, lined with warung restaurants and surf shops.

pois.name: Old Man's
pois.description: Canggu's iconic surf bar and beach club with a mellow wave ideal for beginners.

pois.name: Berawa Beach
pois.description: Quieter beach south of Batu Bolong, home to several beach clubs and a strong shore-break.

pois.name: COMO Uma Canggu
pois.description: Luxury beachside resort with minimalist Balinese architecture, COMO Shambhala Retreat spa, and a rooftop pool.

pois.name: The Layar
pois.description: Award-winning private villa estate with 16 villas, tropical gardens, and a staffed experience.

pois.name: The Slow
pois.description: Artisan boutique hotel with eight unique suites, a rooftop bar, and an art-forward design.

pois.name: Finns Recreation Club
pois.description: Bali's largest recreation club: pools, gym, squash, restaurant, and beach club at Berawa.

pois.name: La Brisa
pois.description: Bohemian beach club built from 500 recycled fishing boats. Signature cocktails and sunset dining.

pois.name: Satu-Satu
pois.description: Third-wave coffee specialty bar in a bamboo-roofed compound. Single-origin roasts from Java and Flores.

pois.name: Sensorium
pois.description: Café and cocktail bar in a tropical garden. Known for creative mocktails and plant-forward brunch.

pois.name: The Shady Shack
pois.description: Beloved plant-based restaurant with an open-air garden, colourful smoothie bowls, and rice plates.

pois.name: Shelter Restaurant
pois.description: Modern Asian dining under a soaring bamboo roof. Weekend brunch is a Canggu institution.

pois.name: Motion
pois.description: Café and co-working space popular with digital nomads. Reliable wifi, iced matcha, and light meals.

pois.name: Brunch Club Bali
pois.description: Casual all-day dining venue with giant acai bowls, smashed avo, and freshly pressed juice.

pois.name: Nook Canggu
pois.description: Perched above a rice field, this café serves healthy bowls and Western brunch against a green backdrop.

pois.name: Sprout
pois.description: Tiny wellness café focused on cold-press juice, raw desserts, and organic superfood plates.

pois.name: Deus Ex Machina
pois.description: Cult motorcycle-surf brand compound: café, barber, surf shop, and custom bike workshop in one complex.

pois.name: Peloton Supershop
pois.description: Cycling concept store with high-end bikes, gear, and a popular café frequented by Canggu cyclists.

pois.name: Love Anchor Market
pois.description: Open-air market and boutique strip with vintage clothing, local designer labels, and surf apparel.

pois.name: Desa Seni
pois.description: Boutique eco-resort and yoga village with daily classes in a garden of antique Javanese houses.

pois.name: Samadi Bali
pois.description: Wellness centre, yoga studio, and organic market in a lush tropical compound.

pois.name: Radiantly Alive
pois.description: Respected yoga school offering drop-in classes, teacher training, and bodywork therapies.

pois.name: Taksu Yoga
pois.description: Ocean-view yoga shala and spa with twice-daily classes and Balinese healing treatments.

pois.name: Canggu Club
pois.description: Sports and leisure club with tennis, pool, gym, and a family-friendly restaurant.

pois.name: Rip Curl School of Surf
pois.description: Established surf school operating from Batu Bolong Beach. Beginner to advanced coaching.

pois.name: Surf Goddess
pois.description: Women-focused surf retreat with daily surf lessons, yoga, and accommodation packages.

pois.name: Odyssey Surf School
pois.description: Small-group surf lessons at Echo Beach, run by local pro surfers with years of coaching experience.

pois.name: Pura Petitenget
pois.description: Important sea temple on the Seminyak-Canggu boundary, part of Bali's spiritual sea-axis.

pois.name: Pura Dalem Canggu
pois.description: Village death temple at the heart of Canggu Banjar, decorated with elaborate stone carvings.

pois.name: Sandbar Canggu
pois.description: Open-air beach bar with fire shows, live DJ sets, and a sand floor. Packs out on weekend nights.

pois.name: Sea Circus
pois.description: Eclectic bar and restaurant known for colourful interior, house music, and jumbo cocktails.

pois.name: Canggu Social
pois.description: Sports bar with pool tables, craft beers on tap, and live sports screenings.

pois.name: Atlas Beach Club
pois.description: Claimed world's largest beach club: 10,000 sqm, 6 pools, and international DJ residencies.

pois.name: Castaway Hostel
pois.description: Social hostel with a pool and rooftop bar. A hub for backpackers and solo travellers in Canggu.

pois.name: Canggu Rice Fields Walk
pois.description: Narrow paths through working rice terraces — the most iconic free experience in Canggu at sunrise.

pois.name: Umalas Stables
pois.description: Horse-riding through rice fields and coastal paths. Sunset beach rides are most popular.

pois.name: Canggu Flea Market
pois.description: Weekly outdoor market (Saturdays) with vintage clothing, jewellery, batik fabrics, and street food.

pois.name: Fins to Feathers Dive
pois.description: Dive shop and freediving centre offering PADI courses and Bali-wide dive trips from Canggu.

pois.name: The Avocado Factory
pois.description: The name says it all: 11 varieties of avocado toast, thick smoothies, and fresh-pressed green juice.

pois.name: Bali Bike Breakfast
pois.description: Morning bicycle tour through Canggu rice paddies and traditional banjar villages with breakfast.

pois.name: Lacalita Beach Bar
pois.description: Mexican-Caribbean beachfront restaurant at Berawa Beach. Frozen margaritas and fresh ceviche.

pois.name: The Lawn
pois.description: Beachfront lawn bar with stunning sunset views, regular live music, and a buzzing happy hour.
